info.text:
Every post we publish gets approved twice. Here's our week.
See our work: https://ka-performancefl.com/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10-09

How we plan a week of posts:

1. Plan the week. Every slot gets a topic, a format and a time. Nothing is made until Alex approves the plan.
2. Write a brief for every post: what the viewer gets, the hook, and where every fact comes from.
3. Build every version: a reel, a swipe carousel and a LinkedIn document.
4. Alex approves every finished post on one page, our Post Desk, or asks for changes.
5. Schedule it, then check what worked. The results shape next week's plan.

This is how we run it for pilot businesses: you approve the month's plan once, and we check every post before it goes out. 3 free months of social media management for 3 Gainesville businesses. Call Alex at 904-210-1071 or message us here.

The posts on screen are samples. The music is AI generated.
